activity.notes: Representative dated activity 1129: Jin shi, juan 80, documents 斜卯阿里 serving the Jin army in operations against the Southern Song court around Mingzhou. His Jin service also includes engagements against Goryeo, Liao and Song in other years. The source does not establish an undisputed exact death year, so no life-year or lifetime military interval is invented.
